column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: these three tests build on newRotationEnv the same as scripts/skip-ledger.d/plugin-secrets-cross-tenant.tsv's pair, so their dialect set (postgres, mssql -- mysql is dropped, see engine/a_secret_never_crosses_tenants_at_the_store_test.go's header for why) matches. mssql is the only skip in this PostgreSQL-only job. Measured by NAME: CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES=<pg> go test ./engine/ -run 'TestPlugin(SecretsRefusesACrossTenantMarkedContext|PayloadsRefusesACrossTenantMarkedContext|SecretsRequestPathPutCreatesOwnRowAndDoesNotTouchAnother)' -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly these three, and postgres itself runs and passes for all three. cleat#1992, cleat-review's #2163 findings 1 and 3: the first two prove Secrets/Payloads refuse a plugin.AcrossAllTenants-marked ctx rather than reproducing beginTenantTx's per-dialect breakage; the third proves a request-path Put creates its own tenant's row and never touches another's.
